items.title: Mike Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2024
items.q: His history of gigs and accomplishments include tours with the Rolling Stones, sessions with Bob Dylan

ctx.x: Yeah that’s like going to graduate school when you get in those situations. Like you can learn what you had at Eastman but you’ve got to add your own ear and intuition.

A hundred percent. And you know there’s a personal dynamic too because you want to know how far you can add input. Because some people don’t really want much more than what they’re saying and you have to try to interpret that and translate it into working for the horns. And then in the case of, like my experience with the Stones with Bobby, you know we wanted to make sure he was comfortable with everything so we had to be — you know we just had to be aware, you know, of who could get bent out of shape if you…

Let’s talk about advice you might give to young musicians today. I believe this is a quote from you from a previous interview and you said, “The inclusion of musicians on everything from CDs to film soundtracks to television commercials and Broadway shows no longer feels like a given but more like a luxury.”
